sql: SELECT "signals"."signalregistry" AS k, (CAST("signals"."polarangledeg" AS REAL) / "signals"."phaseshiftdeg") AS m1 FROM "signals" WHERE (CAST("signals"."polarangledeg" AS REAL) / "signals"."phaseshiftdeg") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: signals.polarization angle relative to phase shift
why: polarization angle / phase shift: a ratio of two quantities in degree
rank signals rows by polarization angle relative to phase shift

sql: SELECT "signals"."signalregistry" AS k, ("signals"."phaseshiftdeg" - "signals"."polarangledeg") AS m1 FROM "signals" WHERE ("signals"."phaseshiftdeg" - "signals"."polarangledeg") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: phase shift - polarization angle: both in degree and of the same kind (stocks) on the same detected signal
rank signals rows by phase shift minus polarization angle
